decisions.choice: Appended the parenthetical marker "(edited)" to the existing line in notes.txt.
decisions.whyItMatters: Keeps notes.txt an accurate, current record while making the edit trivially safe and reversible.

alternatives.consequence: The file would remain exactly as-is and this phase would produce no observable edit.

alternatives.option: Add a whole new line of notes
alternatives.consequence: Would change the file's structure and content more than a minimal one-line edit requires.

recommendation.reason: It is a single, in-place, low-risk change that keeps the note's original meaning intact.

assumptions: notes.txt is the only file and is a plain text file with a single line.
